## 9. WEEK AHEAD / SCENARIO ANALYSIS

| SCENARIO | PROBABILITY | TRIGGER | BRENT | S&P 500 | BTC |
|----------|-------------|---------|-------|---------|-----|
| Bull | 20% | Iran resumes talks; framework for Hormuz reopening emerges; oil drops; Fed hike odds fall; May NFP in-line | $86 | 7,800 | $77,000 |
| Base | 50% | Iran-US standoff persists at current escalation level; oil stays elevated $93-$100; Fed holds but hike risk stays elevated; AI earnings sustain equity floor | $97 | 7,550 | $70,000 |
| Bear | 30% | Iran fully withdraws from diplomacy; Hormuz mines cause first major ship casualty; oil spikes above $105; Fed signals emergency hike consideration; credit spreads widen | $108 | 7,100 | $60,000 |

**Note:** Bear scenario probability raised to 30% from prior 20% following Iran's suspension of peace negotiations and the Oman mine warning — a qualitative escalation that increases the probability of the worst-case path.

### Key Upcoming Catalysts — Week of June 1–6, 2026

1. **Iran Peace Talks Status — Ongoing/Binary**: Iran's suspension of negotiations is the week's primary binary. Any resumption would trigger an oil selloff and equity rally; further military escalation or evidence of expanded Hormuz mining would push oil toward $105+ [Source: https://www.seatrade-maritime.com/security/oman-warns-of-mines-sighted-in-strait-of-hormuz]

2. **May Non-Farm Payrolls — Friday, June 6**: The key US macro data point of the week. Reuters consensus entering last week was 96,000 jobs and unemployment rising to 4.3%. A strong print raises Fed hike probability; a weak print deepens stagflation concerns. CBA's Joseph Capurso flagged NFP as the second co-dominant driver of USD alongside Iran [Source: https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/dollar-steadies-markets-await-signals-iran-war-central-banks-2026-06-01/]

3. **EIA Weekly Crude Oil Inventory Report — Week of June 3-4**: US crude and gasoline inventories have been drawing sharply for weeks. Given today's oil spike to $97/bbl Brent, another drawdown print would accelerate the move toward $100 and force explicit Fed policy recalibration

4. **ECB Rate Decision — Wednesday, June 11**: A 25bp hike to 2.25% deposit rate is widely expected. The ECB's forward guidance language will determine whether EUR/USD recovers from today's 1.1621 level or continues to drift lower against the USD safe-haven bid [Source: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/29/the-ecb-is-debating-rate-hikes-but-the-private-sector-could-help-out.html]

5. **China PMI Data — This Week**: Manufacturing and services PMI will drive AUD, copper, and the KOSPI/Nikkei complex. Any deterioration in Chinese demand signals would compound oil-driven stagflation concerns and hit commodity-linked assets precisely when they are most sensitive
